steps.instruction: Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a small pan.
Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:milk-whole}} slowly, whisking, until smooth.
Cook 5 minutes. Stir in {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Heat the grill to high.
Lay {{ing:ham-slice}} on two slices of {{ing:bread-slice-medium}}.
Top with the other slices. Spoon the sauce over.
Grate {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} on top.
Grill 5 minutes, until bubbling and browned.

recipes.name: French onion soup
recipes.method_note: The onions take 40 minutes and cannot be hurried. That is the recipe.

steps.instruction: Slice {{ing:onion-large}} thinly.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a large pan on a low heat.
Add the onions and {{ing:dried-thyme}}. Stir to coat.
Cook 40 minutes, stirring every few minutes.
steps.note: Deep brown and jammy. Low heat throughout.

steps.instruction: Stir in {{ing:flour-plain}}. Cook 2 minutes.
Add {{ing:stock-chicken}}. Simmer 20 minutes.
Toast {{ing:bread-slice-medium}} and grate {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} on top.
Grill until bubbling, then float on the soup.
Cut {{ing:aubergine}}, {{ing:courgette}} and {{ing:pepper-bell}} into chunks.
Put a large pan on a medium heat with {{ing:olive-oil}}.
Fry the aubergine 8 minutes, until browned. Lift it out.
steps.note: Aubergine drinks oil. Do it alone.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:onion-large}} and cook 8 minutes.
Add the courgette and pepper. Cook 6 minutes.
Chop {{ing:garlic-clove}} and add it with {{ing:dried-thyme}}.
Add {{ing:chopped-tomatoes-tinned}} and the aubergine.
Simmer 25 minutes, until thick.

recipes.name: Cheese omelette
recipes.method_note: Two minutes, start to finish. Have the plate ready.

steps.instruction: Beat {{ing:egg-medium}} with {{ing:salt}} until no streaks are left.
Melt {{ing:butter-block}} in a small pan on a medium heat.
Pour the eggs in. Leave 20 seconds.
Push the set edges into the middle. Tilt to fill the gaps.
Cook 1 minute more, until the top is barely wet.
Grate {{ing:cheddar-cheese}} over one half.
Fold it over and slide onto the plate.

recipes.name: Tuna, egg and green bean salad, niçoise style
recipes.method_note: Everything can be cooked ahead. Dress just before eating.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:potato-medium}} into chunks. Boil 15 minutes, until tender.
Add {{ing:green-beans}} for the last 4 minutes. Drain. Cool under cold water.
Boil {{ing:egg-medium}} 8 minutes. Cool in cold water. Peel and quarter.
Whisk {{ing:olive-oil}}, {{ing:white-wine-vinegar}} and {{ing:mustard-dijon}}.
Tear {{ing:lettuce-iceberg}} onto plates. Add potatoes, beans and halved {{ing:cherry-tomato}}.
Drain {{ing:tuna-tinned-in-spring-water}}. Flake over with the eggs and {{ing:olives-pitted}}.
Drizzle with the dressing.

swaps.text: A tin of butter beans, to make it vegetarian

recipes.name: Sea bass with salsa verde and new potatoes
recipes.method_note: Salsa verde is a sharp green herb sauce. It also lifts lamb, chicken and roast veg.

steps.instruction: Cut {{ing:potato-medium}} into chunks. Boil 15 minutes, until tender.
Chop {{ing:fresh-parsley}}, {{ing:fresh-basil}}, {{ing:capers}} and {{ing:garlic-clove}} very finely.
Stir in 3 tablespoons of the oil, {{ing:mustard-dijon}} and the juice of half the lemon.
Boil {{ing:green-beans}} 4 minutes.
Heat the rest of {{ing:olive-oil}} in a frying pan on a medium-high heat.
Fry {{ing:sea-bass-fillet}} skin side down 3 minutes, pressing flat, until crisp.
Turn. Cook 1 minute.
Serve with potatoes and beans. Spoon salsa verde over. Add wedges of {{ing:lemon}}.

swaps.text: Any white fish or salmon; or halloumi for a vegetarian plate
